Market today: AI is the clear driver, fueling strong gains in cybersecurity and enterprise software. This momentum is critical for your tech/chip-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.18%) and SPAL (-40.36%) are deep in the red and leveraged; margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-12.67%) and QQQI (-3.95%) also need attention. CRWD (+5.18%) is up big today but flagged for TRIM.

Watch: Keep an eye on continued AI-driven strength in cybersecurity. Closely monitor your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay or if their stops are challenged.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losses aggressively while capitalizing on confirmed AI momentum in your core tech names.
plays: SOXL: Consider reducing exposure or tightening your stop. This leveraged position is down over 50% and decays, amplifying margin risk.
SPAL: Review this new, leveraged position down over 40%. Consider reducing size or adjusting its stop given its volatility and decay.
CRWD: Trim into today's strength. Your scanner flagged it, and strong AI news provides an excellent opportunity to take some profit.
